event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ITA 221725 was represented by Enrico Tanferna.
The race committee was represented by Javier Blanco.
Giorgio Poggi (Coach of ITA 221725) and Robert Ohlsson (Course Race Officer) attended the hearing as an observer.
The protest time limit for the ILCA 7 Men Yellow fleet was 17:40 on 11 August 2025.

ITA 221725 submitted a scoring inquiry at 17:38 on 11 August 2025. The race committee published its decision on the scoring inquiry at 19:32. ITA 221725 subsequently submitted a request for redress at 19:38.
The race committee presented video evidence during the hearing.
facts: The race committee displayed the black flag as preparatory signal during the third attempt to start race 1.
The race committee identified ITA 221725 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last seconds before the starting signal.
The race committee signalled a general recall after the starting signal and displayed the sail number of ITA 221725 on the race committee signal boat before the next warning signal.
ITA 221725 did not sail in race 1.
ITA 221725 was scored BFD in race 1.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
